description: Western Province - By-Laws - on the subdivision of Lands within the Pradesheeya Sabha Authority Area and on the Inspection of Subdivided Plans and Building Construction Plans
reasoning: This gazette primarily deals with land subdivision regulations within the authority of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) in the Western Province. It establishes detailed bylaws governing the subdivision of lands for sale, development, maintenance, and administration. The content focuses on land-related matters including registration requirements, development standards, drainage systems, roadways, and compliance procedures for land subdivisions - all falling under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While it mentions government officials (Chief Minister) in the notification section, the core content is specifically about land management regulations rather than government personnel or structural changes.
